recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit as the FHIR-32584 reconciliation. No Extension Pack action or opportunistic related-issue commit is needed because the remaining related issues checked do not change the business-identifier rule.
issue_request: FHIR-32584 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested removal of DocumentReference.content.identifier, documentation on DocumentReference.identifier for different business identifier types such as XDS DocumentEntry.uniqueId using Identifier.type, and a resource-level usage note explaining that multiple DocumentReference resources can point to distinct artifacts while sharing common business identifiers.
initial_application: The Jira-linked merge e1693d10118242ec2bc17e3e275da8a3a1e462d6 included ca42e22e8898847779efb3f173a39b7bcc9ef204, which removed DocumentReference.content.identifier and updated DocumentReference.identifier mappings and examples. Current source retained the removal, but the Identifier.type and non-unique business-identifier guidance was missing, and a later DocumentReference cleanup changed the identifier definition without adding that guidance.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/documentreference files are in current build scope. OO Confluence minutes support the Jira disposition and bounded scope. FHIR-25773 is the earlier same-family issue that moved masterIdentifier into content.identifier; FHIR-32584 superseded that modeling. Nearby FHIR-32791 and FHIR-37444 concern attachment.url/examples and do not alter the identifier guidance.
reconciliation: Updated source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml to document Identifier.type and the non-uniqueness caveat on DocumentReference.identifier, and added the matching resource-level implementation note to source/documentreference/documentreference-notes.xml. No DocumentReference.content.identifier element was reintroduced.
source_changes: source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml: expanded DocumentReference.identifier comment with Identifier.type examples and non-unique business-identifier guidance.

source/documentreference/documentreference-notes.xml: added an Implementation Notes bullet describing business identifiers, Identifier.type, and why DocumentReference.identifier cannot be assumed unique.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue moved masterIdentifier into content.identifier; FHIR-32584 later removed content.identifier and consolidated business identifiers on DocumentReference.identifier.
Later question about DocumentReference.content.attachment.url pointing at a Bundle/Composition; checked because it mentioned content.identifier, but it did not alter identifier uniqueness guidance.
Later request for a composition-pointing example; checked because comments mentioned content.identifier, but its resolution was about attachment.url examples.
